name: 音素相关性分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes phoneme-visual correlation for deepfake detection:

1. **音频音素提取**: The audio track is processed to extract a phoneme sequence with precise temporal alignment. Each phoneme is identified with its onset-offset timestamps and confidence score using speech recognition.

2. **视觉音素(Viseme)检测**: The corresponding visual phoneme (viseme) sequence is extracted from lip/jaw motion analysis. Key visemes include: bilabial closure (/m/, /p/, /b/), labiodental (/f/, /v/), dental (/θ/, /ð/), and open vowels (/a/, /o/).

3. **音素-Viseme时间相关性**: The temporal alignment between audio phonemes and visual visemes is measured. In authentic speech, audio leads visual by ~50ms (auditory-visual speech lag). The method computes cross-correlation to check this temporal relationship. Deepfakes may show incorrect timing between audio and visual speech.

4. **ArticulationCompleteness**: Certain phonemes require specific visual articulations that are physiologically mandatory — /m/ requires complete lip closure, /f/ requires lip-teeth contact. The method checks whether mandatory articulations are achieved. Deepfake lip generators may fail to produce complete target articulations.

5. **Co-Articulation模式验证**: In natural speech, phoneme production is influenced by surrounding phonemes (anticipatory and carry-over coarticulation). The method checks for natural coarticulation effects in the visual speech signal. AI-generated lip movements often lack proper coarticulation, producing discrete viseme transitions.
parameters:
分析类型: sensor
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through phoneme correlation analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Haliassos, A. et al. (2021). Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach To Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Chugh, K. et al. (2020). Not Made for Each Other — Audio-Visual Dissonance-based Deepfake Detection. ACM MM.
